body: Pre-post TYPE-DISCIPLINE BLOCKER on b3f3c35 atlas.scala:151-155: SurfaceDetailSupport is a final case class private carrying a derived proof relation among availableKinds, supportedDetails, and unsupportedTokenIds. In Scala 3, case-class fromProduct can mint this despite the private constructor—the exact construction hole the current 874fc61 core slice is closing for Credence/TextSpan/StorySource. A caller can forge an inconsistent preflight report even though AtlasCompiler safely recomputes its own. Make it a final class private with public vals plus structural equals/hashCode/toString as needed, constructed only by inspect; add an out-of-package construction probe that apply/copy/fromProduct are unavailable. This is anchored to the new public proof API, not a repo-wide concern. SurfaceRail rename remains separately ruled back to SurfaceUnit.
